title: DA-Research: data collection, datasets and analysis for benchmarking six blockchain data availability protocols (Nov 2025 - Feb 2026)
description: Collection tooling, block-level and daily datasets, and analysis/plotting scripts for an empirical benchmark of six production data availability protocols: Polkadot, Ethereum (EIP-4844/PeerDAS), Celestia, Espresso, NEAR and Avail. The datasets cover a 90-day mainnet window (15 Nov 2025 to 14 Feb 2026). Code is licensed under Apache-2.0 and data under CC-BY-4.0.
notes: Funded by the Web3 Foundation Grants Program. Data files are licensed CC-BY-4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA).
